title: Clay ball morphs into a dollhouse building in Seedance 2.0
creator: @aiwithhikari
promptFull: Cozy claymation stop-motion animation. [0-2s] A terracotta clay ball drops from above onto a clean beige surface under soft lattice window shadows, squishing slightly upon impact. [2-4s] The clay dynamically morphs and expands upward, shaping itself into a stylized multi-story clay apartment building with warm, glowing yellow windows and miniature potted plants on the roof. [4-6s] Miniature train tracks spontaneously lay themselves out around the base, and a small blue-and-white clay train begins chugging around the building, puffing fluffy white clay clouds of steam. [6-8s] The entire building magically hinges open down the middle like a dollhouse box, exposing a detailed miniature living room inside with a tiny brown sofa, coffee table, and indoor plants. [8-10s] A shiny golden clay key floats up above the open building, surrounded by a swirling trail of sparkling magic dust as green leaves gently drift through the air. Tactile stop-motion clay texture, soft studio lighting, cute miniature art style, 24fps frame rate.
